_comment: Non-secret config for the DYNGW v2 DTTK console -- distribution tickets reached through the
dynamic gateway (ZFS_SB_DYNGW_O4_API) instead of the dedicated DTTK service. The page is a
copy of web/individual/dttk-console with its transport rerouted: every read and write goes
through RunQuery / ExecuteTableCrud, and the gateway's raw DDIC column names are converted to
the OData-style property names the page already expects.
No password here: it is read from the environment variable named below, falling back to the
gitignored .claude/settings.local.json 'env' block at the repo root.
Port 8776 keeps this server clear of web/individual/ (8765-8772), dyngw-v2-console (8773),
